name: greenroom
description: A local, no-code app for running Playwright end-to-end checks against your live web app and reviewing the results.

scripts.deps:refresh: for p in pantry; do bun add @tjakoen/$p@github:tjakoen/$p#$(git ls-remote https://github.com/tjakoen/$p.git main | cut -c1-7); done && bun update @tjakoen/batch @tjakoen/grain @tjakoen/mill @tjakoen/proof

//dependencies: INTENTIONALLY LOCKLESS (bun.lock gitignored). greenroom -> @tjakoen/pantry(git) -> tjakoen.github.io(git) is a nested github git-dep graph bun cannot resolve from scratch, so the repo RUNS FROM THIS CHECKOUT'S node_modules (a fresh clone can't reinstall from zero until the nesting is flattened — tracked as deploy hardening in plans/platform.md §10). 2026-07-20 grain-monorepo cutover: grain · mill · proof · batch are PUBLISHED packages (GitHub Packages, @tjakoen scope → see .npmrc), pinned ^0.1.x. The sole remaining github git-dep is @tjakoen/pantry, and it is now a devDependency (component-catalog cockpit, never imported at runtime), so a RUNTIME install `bun install --production` resolves cleanly from GitHub Packages (needs GITHUB_TOKEN, see .npmrc) and DOES NOT hit the nested wall — only a full dev install (which pulls pantry for the cockpit) still does, and dev runs from the vendored tree. grain@^0.1.8 (main tip) carries b-select/chip-group/stat-tile/b-meter/status-list + the :focus-visible focus-ring fix natively; the P4 in-browser editor's grain organisms/code-editor chrome is VENDORED into node_modules/@tjakoen/grain until published grain carries it. PLATFORM DEPS (added via incremental `bun add` onto the vendored tree, never a from-scratch resolve): better-auth + @better-auth/sso (accounts/SSO/teams), drizzle-orm (over embedded bun:sqlite), monaco-editor (P4 editor, self-hosted byte-served from node_modules/monaco-editor/min/vs). drizzle-kit is a devDependency (migrations).
